name: orthomcl-in-3d7-missing-from-two-falciparum-strains
turns: Which ortholog groups have a protein in Plasmodium falciparum 3D7 but are missing from at least 2 of the other P. falciparum strains?
rationale: Absence from at least k of N strains is a ceiling on the strain list's taxon count, N minus k, beside presence in the 3D7 genome. The strain list is every P. falciparum genome except 3D7.

provenance.curatorNote: A phyletic pattern over the strains of one species.
